title: Decision
description: The SINGLE decision contract — the OUTPUT of the kernel. Exactly one repo (decision-kernel-core) may emit an instance of this. control-plane, fdk-research, and agent-runtime MUST NOT. This is the most safety-critical schema in the system.

verdict.description: ALLOW = permit as submitted. DENY = refuse. LIMIT = permit only a constrained/minimized form (see obligations/transformed_payload); canonical name for AuthGate's TRANSFORM. CONTAIN = permit ONLY inside a locked-down sandbox (see 'containment') — the defensive response to a suspected-malicious actor: its effect is nullified WITHIN this system's own boundary. DEFER = cannot decide now; escalate. Note: CONTAIN is strictly INTERNAL containment; the Decision OS never acts on, breaks into, or disables an external system (see DEPENDENCY_RULES.md, 'no external enforcement').

reason.description: Deterministic, human-readable justification. No probability, no ML narrative.

action_ref.description: Binds this decision to the exact action it rules on (the action's nonce or a content hash). A decision is only valid for the action_ref it names.

issued_by.description: Identity of the AUTHORITY that produced this decision. MUST be the decision-kernel-core. CI/runtime rejects a decision whose issued_by is not the kernel.

obligations.description: For LIMIT: the constraints applied (e.g. 'redacted:ssn', 'redacted:content:pattern'). Empty for ALLOW/DENY/DEFER.

transformed_payload.description: For LIMIT only: the minimized payload the executor must use instead of the original. Null otherwise.

containment.description: Required when verdict=CONTAIN. The sandbox constraints the executor MUST apply. All are INTERNAL limits on this system's own execution domain — none reach outside it.

sandbox.description: The action runs only in an isolated sandbox.

network.description: Network access inside the sandbox: none, or a restricted allowlist.

allowed_tools.description: Whitelist of tools the contained actor may still call (typically empty/minimal — no sensitive effects).

persistence.description: The contained actor may not persist state beyond the sandbox.

privilege_escalation.description: No privilege escalation is permitted from within containment.

time_limit_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound on the contained execution.

timestamp.description: When the decision was issued (RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC).
